arms.kmer_selection: paper score, k=3 candidates per 512-base chunk
arms.sae_steering: feature 16115 (major capsid), +0.25 during layer-26 prefill and cached decode

design.estimate_note: One L40S worker, 4 CPU cores, 32 GiB memory, capped at 60 minutes using current published Modal rates; setup may add small overhead.

reliability_caveats.orf_closure: exact-coordinate recall test, not a calibrated gene finder; near-zero closure_fraction is expected at long range from the seed and is not by itself evidence of poor generation quality
reliability_caveats.terminators: uncalibrated heuristic; 40 false-positive hits measured on the real phiX174 genome itself, so only relative (not absolute) hit counts should be compared across native/speculative/kmer arms
